TITLE: Asset Page – Work Orders Tab Shows No Count
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: (owning story to confirm — regression item) · PRIORITY: Medium · LABEL: board-tech-view
MY READING: PROBABLY NOT A DEFECT — the only source is a developer test note ("Check rows, counts…"); no requirement says a count is shown.

h2. Description

An asset's *Work Orders* tab should show how many work orders it lists.

For example,
* the tab reads *Work Orders* with no number
* there is no count or "1-3 of 3" under the table

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open *Customers*, open a customer, click its *Assets* tab and open an asset with work orders (e.g. TRK-201 of ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Count).
# Click the asset's *Work Orders* tab.
#* The tab label has no number and there is no count under the table.

*Actual Result:*
* No count is shown for the asset's work orders.

*Expected Result:*
* A count that matches the rows is shown.
